monk.advancements.level.start.desc: With your bare hands, the world will bend
monk.advancements.ability.armor.desc: Your skin is naturally armored (+%s armor while unarmored).
monk.advancements.ability.blindness.desc: As you can clearly see, you cannot clearly see.
monk.advancements.ability.blink.desc: You can now 'blink' across long distances. Hold the Blink key to aim and release it to teleport (change the key in Controls).
monk.advancements.ability.catch_arrows.d: Catch arrows and anything thrown at you from the front with an empty hand: it goes to your inventory. Mastered, you also dodge what comes from behind.
monk.advancements.ability.fly.desc: You have thrown yourself at the ground and missed. You now have the gift of flight.
monk.advancements.ability.health.desc: Your max health is increased by %s
monk.advancements.ability.kiss_creeper.d: Right-click a creeper with an empty hand (even while it is hissing) to kindly ask it not to explode. It will never see you as a threat again.
monk.advancements.ability.lava_protectio: Entering lava makes you immune to fire and lava for a few seconds.
monk.advancements.ability.mining.0.desc: Your hands can now quickly break wooden blocks without tools.
monk.advancements.ability.mining.1.desc: Your hands dig with the hardness and speed of stone tools.
monk.advancements.ability.mining.2.desc: Your hands dig with the hardness and speed of iron tools.
monk.advancements.ability.mining.3.desc: Your hands are harder than diamonds.
monk.advancements.ability.mining.4.desc: Your hands are harder than obsidian.
monk.advancements.ability.mining.5.desc: Your hands can mine any minable material.
monk.advancements.ability.potion_immunit: Harmful effects (poison, wither, slowness...), dragon breath and creeper explosions no longer affect you.
monk.advancements.ability.step_up.desc: You automatically step up full blocks without jumping (sneak to disable).
monk.advancements.ability.strength.desc: Your bare hands do %s extra damage
monk.advancements.ability.swift.desc: You run %s faster (Ctrl + mouse wheel adjusts it)
monk.advancements.ability.tame_animals.d: Pet animals with an empty hand to calm them down or to make them fall in love.
monk.advancements.ability.water_breathin: You can stay underwater much longer and swim faster
You can now walk on water. Sneak to sink.
monk.advancements.ability.withering_star: Your judging stare withers undead and hostile mobs (K turns it on/off)
monk.advancements.requirement.arrow_dodg: Dodge a skeleton's arrows %s times in a row without getting hit
monk.advancements.requirement.bedrock_sl: Sleep upon a "Bed of Rock". Remember to look before you sleep.
monk.advancements.requirement.break_bloc: Break %s "%s" blocks with your bare hands.
monk.advancements.requirement.break_wood: Break %s wood logs with your bare hands.
monk.advancements.requirement.drown: Swim until your lungs nearly burst
monk.advancements.requirement.fall: Take a very high leap of faith onto hay.
monk.advancements.requirement.kill_blind: You are now blind. To restore your sight, slay %s enemies.
monk.advancements.requirement.kill_entit: Fight and kill %s "%s" enemies, using your bare hands.
monk.advancements.requirement.kiss_creep: Kindly ask a creeper not to explode. (Right click it with an empty hand)
monk.advancements.requirement.mediate_su: Meditate while watching a sunset or sunrise.
monk.advancements.requirement.meditate_e: Peacefully coexist among the Endermen without scaring them.
monk.advancements.requirement.meditate_w: Take a boat upon the ocean and contemplate the midnight moon.
monk.advancements.requirement.pet: Pet %s Animals (right click an animal with empty hand to pet)
monk.advancements.requirement.sprint: Sprint %s blocks (time spent jumping does not count).
monk.advancements.requirement.wither_sta: Travel to a nether fortress and win a staring competition against a wither skeleton.
monk.disqualify: Do not use weapons, armor or projectiles
monk.final.0: This is where it all began.
monk.final.11: I am one with all things.
monk.final.12: All things are one with me.
monk.advancements.ability.water_breathin: You never run out of air and swim even faster.
monk.advancements.ability.glass_touch.de: Glass broken with your bare hands does not shatter.
monk.advancements.requirement.sleep_cact: Sleep on a cactus at night. Remember to look before you sleep.
monk.advancements.requirement.none: Nothing to do: this level is granted immediately.
monk.command.info.max: Fully ascended: there is nothing left to learn.
monk.command.setlevel: Set the monk level of %s player(s) to %s
monk.config.title: Monk Mod
monk.config.open_folder.desc: Opens config/monk. levels.json lets you add or remove levels; README.txt lists every ability and requirement.
monk.config.no_yacl: Install YetAnotherConfigLib to edit the settings in game.
monk.config.no_yacl.2: You can also edit config/monk/*.json and run /monk reload.
monk.config.saved_with_errors: Monk Mod settings saved with %s problem(s):
monk.config.hud.desc: The indicator that shows progress towards your next level.
monk.config.hud.enabled.desc: Show the progress indicator at all.
monk.config.hud.style.desc: Ring (like the original), bar or plain text.
monk.config.hud.offset_x.desc: Distance from the side of the screen.
monk.config.hud.offset_y.desc: Distance from the top/bottom of the screen.
monk.config.hud.size.desc: Size of the indicator in GUI pixels.
monk.config.hud.show_percent.desc: Show the percentage next to the indicator.
monk.config.hud.show_icon.desc: Draw the next level's icon inside the ring.
monk.config.hud.always_visible.desc: Keep the indicator on screen instead of fading out.
monk.config.hud.visible_ticks.desc: How long the indicator stays after progress changes (20 ticks = 1 second).
monk.config.blink.desc: The Blink ability (level 11 by default). Server settings.
monk.config.blink.fall_damage.desc: Damage taken on each blink, like an ender pearl (0 = none).
monk.config.blink.preview.desc: Show particles where you will land while holding the key.
monk.config.blink.require_unarmored.desc: Blink only works while wearing no armor.
monk.config.gameplay.announce.desc: Level advancements are announced to everyone.
monk.config.gameplay.action_bar.desc: Also show 'level: x / y' above the hotbar when progress changes.
monk.config.gameplay.info_everyone.desc: Let every player use /monk info (otherwise operators only).
monk.config.performance.desc: Bigger intervals = less CPU, slightly less precise checks.
monk.config.performance.stare.desc: Ticks between stare ray casts (Withering Stare, staring contest).
monk.config.performance.enderman.desc: Ticks between enderman scans for the meditation challenge.
monk.config.performance.equipment.desc: Ticks between armor/weapon checks (changes are also detected instantly).
monk.config.equipment.info: Monks fight without weapons or armor. Items that give attack or armor bonuses count as such.
monk.config.equipment.strict.desc: Anything worn in an armor slot counts as armor (except allowed items).
monk.config.equipment.whitelist.desc: Item ids monks may hold or wear freely. The item tag #monk:monk_safe works too.
monk.config.equipment.blacklist.desc: Item ids that always break the monk rules. The item tag #monk:monk_forbidden works too.
monk.config.abilities.info: Untick an ability to disable it everywhere, whatever level grants it.
monk.config.levels.info: %s levels. Edit the values below; to add/remove levels or change a challenge type, edit levels.json and use /monk reload.
monk.config.levels.reset.desc: Restores the 21 original levels immediately (other unsaved changes on this screen are lost).
monk.config.levels.level.desc: Challenge to unlock this level and the abilities it grants.
monk.advancements.ability.night_vision.d: Press the Night Vision key (V) to see in the dark. Press it again to turn it off.
monk.controls.night_vision.locked: You haven't unlocked night vision yet.
monk.config.blink.allow_air.desc: Off: you only land on a block (or water), so you can't blink into the sky by mistake. On: you can blink to any free spot.
monk.config.blink.min_range.desc: Shortest distance you can choose with Blink key + mouse wheel.
monk.config.blink.ground_depth.desc: When you aim at nothing, look this many blocks below the aim point for ground to land on (0 = off).
monk.config.flight.desc: Limits of the flight speed monks can choose (vanilla speed is 0.05).
monk.config.flight.max_speed.desc: Fastest flight speed allowed (0.05 = vanilla, 0.1 = twice as fast).
monk.config.controls.desc: Mouse wheel shortcuts. Only one works at a time: Blink key first, then Sprint (Ctrl), then Jump (Space).
monk.config.controls.info: Hold the key and scroll. Prefer plain keys? Turn the wheel off here and bind the +/- keys in Options > Controls > Monk.
monk.config.controls.scroll_blink.desc: While holding the Blink key, the mouse wheel changes how far you teleport.
monk.config.controls.scroll_run.desc: While holding the Sprint key, the mouse wheel changes how much of the Swiftness bonus you use.
monk.config.controls.scroll_fly.desc: While flying and holding the Jump key, the mouse wheel changes your flight speed.
monk.config.controls.blink_step.desc: Blocks added or removed per wheel notch.
monk.config.controls.run_step.desc: Change per wheel notch (0.1 = 10% of your level's bonus).
monk.config.controls.max_run_scale.desc: Highest running bonus, reached at the last level. When Swiftness is unlocked you can choose 0–100%; the maximum grows with each level up to this value (2 = 200%).
monk.config.controls.fly_step.desc: Change per wheel notch (vanilla flight speed is 0.05).
monk.config.controls.show_changes.desc: Show the new value above the hotbar when it changes.
monk.config.levels.name: Level title
monk.config.levels.name.desc: Custom title for this level's advancement. Empty = default ("Level N").
monk.config.levels.custom_name.desc: Custom name for this ability. Empty = translated default name.
monk.config.levels.custom_desc.desc: Custom description for this ability. Empty = translated default description.
monk.type.ability.armor: Natural armor points while wearing no armor.
monk.type.ability.armor_toughness: Natural armor toughness while wearing no armor.
monk.type.ability.swift: Run faster while unarmored (bonus doubled while sprinting). Does not change your FOV; Ctrl + mouse wheel adjusts it.
monk.type.ability.jump: Jump higher and take fall damage later.
monk.type.ability.step_up: Walk up full blocks without jumping (hold sneak to disable).
monk.type.ability.water_breathing_partia: Hold your breath much longer and swim faster.
monk.type.ability.lava_protection: Entering lava makes you immune to fire for a while (no potion effect).
monk.type.ability.mining: Mine with your hands (also while holding an item or the wrong tool).
monk.type.ability.potion_immunity: Immune to the listed effects; can also block dragon breath and creeper explosions.
monk.type.ability.fly: Creative-style flight while unarmored. Space + mouse wheel changes the speed.
monk.type.ability.withering_stare: Looking at undead (and hostile mobs) withers them.
monk.type.ability.blink: Teleport where you look with the Blink key (G). Blink key + mouse wheel changes the distance.
monk.type.ability.catch_arrows: Catch projectiles flying at you from the front; they go to your inventory.
monk.type.ability.kiss_creeper: Right-click a creeper with an empty hand to ask it not to explode; calmed creepers never explode.
monk.type.ability.night_vision: Toggle night vision with its key (V by default).
monk.type.ability.tame_animals: Pet animals to calm them or make them fall in love.
monk.type.ability.glass_touch: Break glass bare-handed without shattering it.
monk.type.requirement.break_block: Break N blocks (or a #tag) with an empty hand.
monk.type.requirement.break_wood: Break N logs with an empty hand.
monk.type.requirement.drown: Stay underwater until almost out of air.
monk.type.requirement.mediate_sunrise: Look at the sun at sunrise or sunset.
monk.type.requirement.pet: Pet N different animals with an empty hand.
monk.type.requirement.sprint: Sprint a distance unarmored (jumps don't count).
monk.type.requirement.kill_blind: Kill N hostile mobs unarmed; cures blindness.
monk.type.requirement.kill_entity_type: Defeat N mobs of a type in fair melee (25%+ of its health, no armor/weapons/projectiles).
monk.type.requirement.fall: Fall from high up onto a block (hay).
monk.type.requirement.kiss_creeper: Ask a creeper kindly not to explode (empty hand).
monk.type.requirement.arrow_dodge: Dodge N skeleton arrows in a row.
monk.type.requirement.meditate_water_moo: From a boat, look at the midnight moon.
monk.type.requirement.wither_stare: Stare down a wither skeleton in a nether fortress.
monk.type.requirement.meditate_endermen: Stay near endermen without angering them.
monk.type.requirement.void_fall: Fall into the void and come back.
monk.param.strength.damage.desc: Damage points added to unarmed attacks.
monk.param.health.health_increase.desc: Multiplier added to base max health (0.5 = +50%).
monk.param.swift.sprint_multiplier.desc: Bonus multiplier while sprinting (2 = double bonus).
monk.param.swift.only_unarmored.desc: Only works while wearing no armor.
monk.param.jump.safe_fall.desc: Extra blocks you can fall without damage.
monk.param.step_up.height.desc: Total step height in blocks (vanilla is 0.6).
monk.param.feather_fall.multiplier.desc: Fraction of fall damage still taken (0.2 = 80% less).
monk.param.water_breathing_partial.infin: Never run out of air at all.
monk.param.water_breathing_partial.swim_: Extra swimming speed (0.33 = like Depth Strider I, 1 = Depth Strider III).
monk.param.water_breathing_partial.hide_: Hide the air bubbles above the hotbar.
monk.param.water_breathing_full.swim_spe: Extra swimming speed (0.33 = like Depth Strider I, 1 = Depth Strider III).
monk.param.water_breathing_full.hide_bub: Hide the air bubbles above the hotbar.
monk.param.fire_resistance.multiplier.de: Fraction of fire damage still taken (0.5 = half).
monk.param.explosion_resistance.multipli: Fraction of explosion damage still taken (0.5 = half).
monk.param.lava_protection.duration.desc: Immunity duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
monk.param.lava_protection.cooldown.desc: Ticks before it can trigger again.
monk.param.lava_protection.infinite.desc: Always immune to fire and lava.
monk.param.hunger.hunger_chance.desc: How much slower hunger drains (0.5 = 50% slower, 0.9 = 90% slower, 1 = never hungry). Also covers the hunger spent on natural healing.
monk.param.mining.harvest_level.desc: 0 wood, 1 stone, 2 iron, 3 diamond, 4 netherite, 5 anything.
monk.param.mining.speed_increase.desc: Bare-hand mining speed bonus (2 = 3x as fast).
monk.param.mining.harvest_tools.desc: Tool kinds your hands replace: pickaxe, shovel, axe, hoe ("" = blocks that need no tool).
monk.param.potion_immunity.ignored_effec: Effects you are immune to. Extra entries: monk:dragon_breath (dragon breath), monk:creeper_explosion (creeper explosions), * (every harmful effect).
monk.param.withering_stare.wither_boss_d: Damage dealt to the Wither boss per stare check.
monk.param.catch_arrows.max_angle_dot.de: How far to the side projectiles can be caught (higher = wider).
monk.param.kiss_creeper.passive.desc: Creepers never chase or explode at you at all, even without asking.
Name shown in the description (plain text or JSON text).
monk.controls.stare.locked: You haven't unlocked the withering stare yet.
monk.param.water_walking.height.desc: Height of your feet inside the water block. 0.89 = feet right on the surface (recommended). 1 = a pixel above. Below 0.89 your feet touch the water and the game treats you as swimming (slower, splashes).
monk.param.water_walking.lift.desc: Walking in from the shore or dropping in from a low height puts you back on the surface. While swimming you are not pulled up: jump out of the water and the surface catches you.
monk.time_stop.locked: You haven't unlocked the time stop yet.
monk.advancements.ability.time_stop.desc: Press the Stop Time key (J) to freeze the world for %s seconds: only you keep moving. Press again to end it early.
monk.advancements.ability.iron_body.desc: You take %s less damage of every kind while wearing no armor
monk.advancements.ability.regeneration.d: After %s seconds without fighting, your wounds slowly close
monk.type.ability.time_stop: Stop time with its key (J): only players keep moving.
monk.type.ability.iron_body: Take less damage of every kind while wearing no armor.
monk.type.ability.regeneration: Heal slowly after some time without fighting.
Also withers every hostile mob (creepers, spiders...), not only the undead.
monk.param.catch_arrows.catch_all.desc: Catch tridents, snowballs, eggs, ender pearls, potions, fireworks and fire charges, not only arrows.
monk.param.catch_arrows.to_inventory.des: Caught projectiles go to your inventory (dropped at your feet if it is full).
monk.param.catch_arrows.require_empty_ha: You need an empty main hand to catch.
monk.param.catch_arrows.back_dodge.desc: Projectiles coming from behind are dodged: they fly through without hitting you.
monk.param.catch_arrows.back_catch_chanc: With dodge from behind: chance to catch the projectile instead of only dodging it (0.2 = 20%).
monk.param.iron_body.multiplier.desc: Fraction of damage still taken (0.6 = 40% less).
monk.param.regeneration.delay.desc: Ticks without dealing or taking damage before healing starts (1800 = 90 seconds, 20 ticks = 1 second).
monk.param.regeneration.amount.desc: Health restored each time (1 = half a heart).
monk.param.time_stop.duration.desc: How long time stays stopped, in ticks (600 = 30 seconds).
monk.param.time_stop.cooldown.desc: Ticks before it can be used again (1200 = 60 seconds).
monk.param.time_stop.flight.desc: You can fly while time is stopped.
monk.config.gameplay.heavy_slowdown.desc: Monks lose this much speed per heavy armor piece (0.15 = 15% each). 0 = off.
monk.config.gameplay.heavy_no_tools.desc: Monks wearing heavy armor can't break blocks with pickaxes or axes.
monk.config.gameplay.heavy_list.desc: Item ids that count as heavy armor.
monk.param.water_breathing_partial.swim_: Extra swimming speed added every tick (0.06 = about twice as fast, 0 = off).
monk.param.water_breathing_full.swim_boo: Extra swimming speed added every tick (0.06 = about twice as fast, 0 = off).
monk.param.water_breathing_partial.hold_: You stay at your depth: sneak to go down, press jump once to stop going down.
monk.param.water_breathing_full.hold_dep: You stay at your depth: sneak to go down, press jump once to stop going down.
monk.param.hunger.movement_reduction.des: Extra reduction while sprinting or swimming (0.6 = 60% less on top of the normal reduction). Running faster with Swiftness never costs more hunger than normal running.
monk.param.water_walking.max_fall.desc: Falls higher than this (in blocks) dive into the water instead of landing on it. You then sink until you press jump.
